# DNS packet fixtures

Deterministic packet bytes are checked into the native tests as immutable byte arrays
in `tests/dns/dns_tests.c`; the UDP/TCP exchange fixture is generated by
`tests/integration/dns_fixture_test.py`. Their addresses use RFC 5737 (`192.0.2.0/24`) and RFC
3849 (`2001:db8::/32`) documentation ranges and contain no captured user data.

`fuzz/dns/corpus/seeds.txt` contains the equivalent packet corpus in auditable hex form.
Release tooling may decode those entries to binary corpus artifacts for libFuzzer.
